vat_explanation: UK freight is normally standard-rated; qualifying international freight and certain import/export-related transport can be zero-rated or outside scope.

name: Carriage and freight outwards
mtd_itsa_category: Other business expenses
vat_explanation: UK freight is normally standard-rated; qualifying international freight and certain import/export-related transport can be zero-rated or outside scope.

name: Commissions payable
mtd_itsa_category: Other business expenses
vat_explanation: Commission is normally standard-rated, but exempt financial intermediation or place-of-supply rules can alter the treatment.

name: Rent
mtd_itsa_category: Rent, rates, power, and insurance costs
vat_explanation: Property rent is normally exempt, but an option to tax or specific property rules can make it taxable.

name: Insurance
mtd_itsa_category: Rent, rates, power, and insurance costs

name: Service charges
mtd_itsa_category: Rent, rates, power, and insurance costs
vat_explanation: Service charges can follow the VAT treatment of the associated property rent; separately supplied property services are normally standard-rated.

name: Water rates
mtd_itsa_category: Rent, rates, power, and insurance costs
vat_explanation: Water and sewerage are commonly zero-rated, but supplies to certain industrial activities can be standard-rated.

name: Light, heating and power
mtd_itsa_category: Rent, rates, power, and insurance costs
vat_explanation: Business fuel and power are normally standard-rated; qualifying domestic, charity non-business or de minimis supplies can be reduced-rated.

name: Gas
mtd_itsa_category: Rent, rates, power, and insurance costs
vat_explanation: Business gas is normally standard-rated; qualifying domestic, charity non-business or de minimis supplies can be reduced-rated.

name: Electricity
mtd_itsa_category: Rent, rates, power, and insurance costs
vat_explanation: Business electricity is normally standard-rated; qualifying domestic, charity non-business or de minimis supplies can be reduced-rated.

name: Motor expenses
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: This is a broad motor-expense account; the VAT treatment depends on the underlying cost.

name: Fuel and oil
vat_recoverability: Private use of road fuel can require a specific input-tax method, including restriction of input tax or use of the fuel scale charge.
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses

name: EV charging
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: Public charging is standard-rated. Charging at home is at the domestic rate and the business proportion has to be worked out.

name: Vehicle repairs and servicing
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses

name: Vehicle licences
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses

name: Vehicle insurance
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses

name: Parking and tolls
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: Commercial parking is normally standard-rated; statutory on-street parking, congestion charges and some public tolls can be outside scope.

name: Vehicle hire and leasing
vat_recoverability: Input VAT on leased cars is normally subject to a 50% block where private use is available; separately identified maintenance may be recoverable under the normal rules.
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses

name: Other Vehicle expenses
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: This is a broad motor-expense account; VAT treatment depends on the underlying cost.

name: Car wash
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: Hand car washes are often not VAT registered, so there is frequently nothing to recover.

name: Water, tissues and newspapers for passengers
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: Bottled water and newspapers are zero-rated. Tissues are standard-rated.

name: Travelling
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: Travel can include zero-rated passenger transport, standard-rated taxis, hotels and other costs, so the treatment depends on the underlying supply.

name: Travel - rail air and sea
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: Qualifying passenger transport by rail, air and sea is generally zero-rated, but ancillary or non-qualifying services can have a different treatment.

name: Taxi and private hire
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: Taxi and private-hire services are normally standard-rated when supplied by a VAT-registered operator; other supplier circumstances can result in no VAT being charged.

name: Hotels and accommodation
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: UK hotel accommodation is normally standard-rated; overseas accommodation and certain long-stay or specialist arrangements can have a different UK VAT treatment.

name: Overseas travel
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: Overseas travel commonly includes supplies outside the scope of UK VAT or foreign VAT, while UK legs, booking fees or other components can have a different treatment.

name: Subsistence
mtd_itsa_category: Car, van, and travel expenses
vat_explanation: Subsistence can include standard-rated restaurant and hot takeaway food as well as qualifying zero-rated food.

name: Business entertainment
vat_recoverability: Input VAT is normally blocked on business entertainment of UK clients and other non-employees; specific exceptions can apply, including qualifying overseas-customer entertainment.
mtd_itsa_category: Business entertainment costs
vat_explanation: The underlying food, drink or entertainment can have different VAT liabilities.

name: Staff entertainment
mtd_itsa_category: Wages, salaries, and other staff costs
vat_explanation: The underlying food, drink or entertainment can have different VAT liabilities.

name: Printing, postage and stationery
mtd_itsa_category: Phone, fax, stationery, and other office costs
vat_explanation: This combined account can contain standard-rated stationery/postage and qualifying zero-rated printed matter.

name: Printing
mtd_itsa_category: Phone, fax, stationery, and other office costs
vat_explanation: Printing is normally standard-rated, but qualifying books, brochures, leaflets and similar printed matter can be zero-rated.

name: Postage & Courier Services
mtd_itsa_category: Phone, fax, stationery, and other office costs
vat_explanation: Commercial courier and delivery services are normally standard-rated, while qualifying Royal Mail universal postal services are exempt.

name: Stationery and office supplies
mtd_itsa_category: Phone, fax, stationery, and other office costs

name: Telephone
mtd_itsa_category: Phone, fax, stationery, and other office costs
vat_explanation: UK telecoms are normally standard-rated; overseas or bundled services can have a different UK VAT treatment.

name: Telephone and mobile
mtd_itsa_category: Phone, fax, stationery, and other office costs
vat_explanation: UK telephone and mobile services are normally standard-rated; overseas or bundled services can have a different UK VAT treatment.

name: Internet and broadband
mtd_itsa_category: Phone, fax, stationery, and other office costs
vat_explanation: UK internet services are normally standard-rated; overseas or bundled services can have a different UK VAT treatment.

name: Computer costs
mtd_itsa_category: Phone, fax, stationery, and other office costs

name: Software and subscriptions
mtd_itsa_category: Phone, fax, stationery, and other office costs
vat_explanation: UK software and subscriptions are normally standard-rated; overseas SaaS commonly gives rise to reverse-charge treatment instead.

name: Website and hosting
mtd_itsa_category: Advertising
vat_explanation: UK website and hosting services are normally standard-rated; overseas suppliers commonly give rise to reverse-charge treatment instead.

vat_explanation: Qualifying subscriptions to certain non-profit professional or trade bodies can be exempt; other memberships and services can be standard-rated or mixed.
